preConditions.onFailMessage: Queued copies of the general role notice are open again after 20261114013648-harvest-role-change-notifications.xml closed them, so a server of the previous release ran beside an upgrade. Stop every role. Close the open copies with the statements of its change set 1794580948952-1, or restore a backup from before the upgrade that first applied that file. Then upgrade again in the stopped window.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM agent_action WHERE kind = 'EMAIL' AND state IN ('PROPOSED', 'ADMITTED', 'EXECUTING') AND payload ->> 'kind' = 'ACCOUNT_SECURITY_CHANGED' AND payload #>> '{event,kind}' = 'APP_ROLE_CHANGED'
SELECT count(*) FROM event_publication WHERE event_type = 'de.tum.cit.aet.hephaestus.core.event.AccountSecurityChangedEvent' AND serialized_event::jsonb ->> 'kind' = 'APP_ROLE_CHANGED'

changeSet.comment: Records the data correction of 20261114013648-harvest-role-change-notifications.xml change set 1794580948952-1, which reached main without its safeguards and so cannot change. That correction closed the queued copies of the general role notice (ACCOUNT_SECURITY_CHANGED with APP_ROLE_CHANGED): a copy whose send had started became UNCERTAIN, every other one CANCELLED, each without its payload. It deleted their open event publications. Role-change emails replaced the general notice, so no later code writes those rows again. The precondition proves that the correction holds. A rollback stops here and names the backup, because the closed rows cannot be rebuilt. The stop also holds back the rollback of every earlier change set.

rollback.stop: The role notice correction of 20261114013648-harvest-role-change-notifications.xml cannot be reversed. Restore the backup taken before the upgrade.
